item.title: Work Mode: Stay Awake & Protected with Proximity Lock
item.description: Abstract Have you ever come back to your Mac and realized it went to sleep before the work was finished? I have. 😅 Large uploads, iCloud syncs, video exports, photo imports, Docker containers, long Xcode builds, AI coding agents, or a huge game download all need time. You should not have to stay beside your Mac just to keep them running. That is why I built Work Mode into Proximity Lock: Smart AutoLock.
